question: Which god is 'first' (the creation account)

versions.Heliopolis: Atum-Ra is the self-created first god
versions.Hermopolis: The Ogdoad (eight primeval deities) are first

how_we_present_it: We present all three as genuinely competing accounts, not as one story with variants. We do NOT silently choose one.

question: The identity of the 'Eye of Ra'

versions.S4: The Eye is variously identified with Tefnut, Hathor, Sekhmet, or Wadjet

how_we_present_it: We note the fluidity; the Eye is a concept, not a fixed goddess.

question: The 'two Horuses'

versions.S4: The sky-falcon Horus and the 'son of Osiris' Horus are sometimes the same, sometimes distinct

how_we_present_it: We store both and note the inconsistency in the sources.

question: Set's character

versions.Late (Greco-Roman): An outright 'evil' figure, the god of Egypt's enemies

how_we_present_it: We present the development over time; we do not flatten Set into a simple villain.

question: Osiris as 'lord of the dead'

versions.Pyramid Texts (early): Osiris is one of the blessed dead
versions.Later (Middle Kingdom on): Osiris becomes the lord of all the dead and the judge of the afterlife

how_we_present_it: We note the development; the 'judge of the dead' role is a later accretion.

question: The dating of the myths

versions.Archaeological: The gods are worshipped from at least c. 3100 BCE
versions.Literary: The main texts (Pyramid Texts, Book of the Dead) are c. 2400 BCE and c. 1250 BCE

how_we_present_it: We make clear that the worship is much older than the surviving texts.
